verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an LLM gateway that handles and stores request data, so the axis applies. The pack shows no retention settings, deletion controls, or zero-retention options. EU routing (data residency) and guardrails (sensitive-content scanning) are adjacent privacy features, not retention or deletion control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
